Name: MythicPhoenix's Mythical Hares
Author: MythicFenix
Description:
Change the default rabbit to one of four mythical ones by editing the config file.  Options are: Jackalope, Snow Bunny, Dust Bunny, and Killer Rabbit.  If you notice any errors please let me know.  Thank you and I hope you enjoy it!

[code][size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][/code]
